detailed_description:
The target video is in a live-action cinematic style with warm late-afternoon lighting, soft shallow depth of field, and a gentle romantic mood.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes <Subject 3>, a sunlit urban park with a tree-lined paved path, soft green lawn, scattered benches, distant blurred pedestrians, and warm golden light filtering through the leaves. <Subject 1>, the young man with tousled brown hair in a dark embossed long leather coat, dark trousers, knee-high black boots, black gloves, wide belt, and hip-hung sword, walks forward on the left side of the path. <Subject 2>, the young woman with a high ponytail in a white-and-pale-lavender embroidered dress, sheer flowing white capelet, white gloves, and white knee-high heeled boots, walks beside him on the right. Their inner hands are gently clasped together, fingers loosely intertwined. The camera tracks backward ahead of them at slow speed, keeping both figures centered from the knees up. <Subject 1> glances sideways at <Subject 2> with a small soft smile; <Subject 2> looks forward, her sheer capelet and ponytail swaying gently with each step, and then turns her eyes toward him with a matching smile. Dappled light moves across their faces and costumes as they continue walking.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a medium two-shot at a slight three-quarter angle. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> slow their steps and turn to face each other on the path, their joined hands still held between them. The background becomes a soft bokeh of green foliage and warm sunlight. <Subject 1> tilts his head slightly downward toward <Subject 2>; the long leather coat shifts on his shoulders, and the sword at his hip catches a brief glint of light. <Subject 2> tilts her head upward toward him, the sheer capelet drifting in a faint breeze. Both maintain warm eye contact, their lips curving into a clear, affectionate smile.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a close two-shot framing them from the upper chest up, side by side, with their joined hands no longer visible in the frame. <Subject 1> on the left looks right into <Subject 2>'s eyes; <Subject 2> on the right looks left into <Subject 1>'s eyes. Their smiles deepen into a quiet, joyful expression, the late-afternoon sun warming the side of their faces, the embroidered silver details of <Subject 2>'s dress and the embossed armor panels of <Subject 1>'s coat softly catching the light. The video holds on this gaze and smile through the final frame.

overall_soundscape: Soft late-afternoon park ambience with distant birdsong, faint rustle of leaves in a light breeze, the gentle tap of boot heels and white heeled boots on the paved path, and a subtle whisper of fabric from the sheer capelet and long leather coat as the two characters walk and turn.

non_diegetic_music: A warm solo-piano melody at a slow tempo with soft sustained strings underneath, rising gently into a tender swell at the final close two-shot and fading into silence on the last frame.
